verdict.rationale: Convertio documents broad first-party format coverage (more than 25,600 conversions across 300+ formats) and lists a dedicated Presentation Converter, which plausibly covers PowerPoint. The evidence never names Word, Excel, or PDF conversion specifically, so the core of the story is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Word/Excel/PowerPoint-to-PDF conversion, evidence of conversion between office formats (e.g. DOCX↔ODT, XLSX↔CSV), and independent or hands-on corroboration of output fidelity.
